title: Crusader of Centy
subtitle: A sword and an unfamiliar voice
summary: Crusader of Centy is Nextech's overhead action adventure, first released for Mega Drive in Japan on 17 June 1994.
body: Crusader of Centy is Nextech's overhead action adventure, first released for Mega Drive in Japan on 17 June 1994. Known as Soleil in Europe, it follows Corona, a boy who receives his father's sword when he turns fourteen. He begins exploring a world threatened by monsters, fighting directly with the sword and solving obstacles along the way. A change in his ability to communicate soon alters the journey: he loses the capacity to speak with people and gains the ability to understand animals and plants instead.

Animals encountered during the adventure can become travelling companions, lending Corona abilities when equipped. His dog can restrain an enemy, while a penguin gives the sword an ice attack. Two abilities can be equipped at once, so choosing companions changes both fighting and access to the landscape. New powers create a gradual sense of growth without relying on conventional experience levels. The animal cast also makes exploration personal: another creature joining the group can provide a solution to a barrier the player has already noticed elsewhere.

The story eventually restores Corona's ability to speak with people and takes him through time to investigate the conflict between monsters and humanity. Earlier assumptions acquire another meaning as he learns more about that history. Producer and writer Yayoi Onda designed the adventure around the gradual acquisition of skills, with the animal companions becoming central to its world. The result gives its approachable swordplay a changing perspective: progress comes from learning what others can do, then using that knowledge to reach places and understand events that were previously closed to him.
